generalTerms.label: 1. General Terms
generalTerms.title: 1. General Terms
generalTerms.content: PhysioGuidance is committed to providing high-quality medical education in compliance with the National eLearning Center (NELC) and the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS). By enrolling in our courses, learners agree to abide by the policies outlined below. These policies are subject to updates in accordance with the regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

attendancePolicy.label: 2. Attendance Policy
attendancePolicy.title: 2. Attendance Policy (CME Requirements)
attendancePolicy.intro: To ensure the integrity of Continuing Medical Education (CME) hours, attendance monitoring is strictly enforced:

items.item1: Live Online Courses: Learners must attend at least 80% of the live lecture duration to qualify for a certificate. Attendance is tracked automatically via system logs.
items.item2: Recorded Training Courses: Learners must view 100% of the video content and complete all interactive modules.
items.item3: Failure to Attend: If the minimum attendance is not met, the learner will not be eligible for CME hours and must retake the course.

assessment.label: 3. Assessment & Grades
assessment.title: 3. Assessment & Grades
assessment.passingGrade: Passing Grade: A minimum score of 70% on the final assessment is required to generate a completion certificate.
assessment.retakePolicy: Retake Policy: Learners are granted three (3) attempts to pass the final exam. If the learner fails all three attempts, they must re-enroll in the course to reset their progress.
assessment.feedback: Feedback: Formative feedback is provided immediately after exam submission to facilitate learning retention.

academicIntegrity.label: 4. Academic Integrity
academicIntegrity.title: 4. Academic Integrity
academicIntegrity.intro: PhysioGuidance enforces a zero-tolerance policy towards academic dishonesty.

items.item1: Identity Verification: Learners must use their SCFHS license number and legal name. Impersonation is a violation of Saudi law.
items.item2: Plagiarism & Cheating: Any attempt to manipulate assessment results or share exam answers will result in immediate account suspension and cancellation of any certificates issued.

intellectualProperty.label: 5. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.title: 5. Intellectual Property Rights
intellectualProperty.intro: All course materials, including videos, slides, PDFs, and assessments, are the exclusive property of PhysioGuidance and its instructors.

items.item1: Usage: Materials are intended for personal educational use only.
items.item2: Distribution: Unauthorized recording, reproduction, or sharing of course content on public platforms is strictly prohibited and subject to legal action under Saudi intellectual property laws.

refundPolicy.label: 6. Cancellation & Refunds
refundPolicy.title: 6. Cancellation & Refund Policy
refundPolicy.courseCancel: Course Cancellation: If PhysioGuidance cancels a live training course, learners are entitled to a 100% refund or credit for future courses.

items.item1: Self-paced Training Courses: Refunds are available within 48 hours of purchase, provided the learner has not accessed more than 10% of the content or attempted the final exam.
items.item2: Live Training Courses: Refunds are available up to 3 days before the start date. No refunds will be issued for "no-shows".

technicalRequirements.label: 7. Technical Requirements
technicalRequirements.title: 7. Technical Requirements
technicalRequirements.intro: To ensure a smooth learning experience, learners must have:

items.item1: A stable internet connection (download speed of at least 2 Mbps).
items.item2: A compatible device (desktop, laptop, or tablet) with an updated web browser (Chrome, Safari, or Edge).
items.item3: Speakers or headphones for audio content.

privacyData.label: 8. Privacy & Data Protection
privacyData.title: 8. Privacy & Data Protection
privacyData.intro: We adhere to the national data management policies issued by SDAIA (Saudi Data & AI Authority).

items.item1: Data Usage: Your personal data (name, license number, and email) is shared strictly with SCFHS (Mumaris Plus) for the purpose of recording CME hours.
items.item2: Confidentiality: We do not sell or share your data with third-party advertisers.

faq.enrollment_q1: How do I enroll in a course?
faq.enrollment_a1: Navigate to the Courses page, select the course you want to join, and click the 'Enroll' button. If the course requires payment, you'll be guided through the checkout process.
faq.enrollment_q2: Can I drop a course after enrolling?
faq.enrollment_a2: Yes, you can drop a course from your My Courses page. Please note that dropping a course may affect your records depending on the course policy.
faq.enrollment_q3: What is the maximum number of courses I can enroll in?
faq.enrollment_a3: There is no fixed limit. However, some courses may have enrollment caps based on NELC regulations (40 learners for long courses, 50 for short courses).
faq.sessions_q1: How do I join a Zoom lecture?
faq.sessions_a1: Go to your My Courses page, find the course with a scheduled live lecture, and click 'Join Lecture'. You'll be redirected to the Zoom meeting link provided by your instructor.
faq.sessions_q2: What happens if I miss a lecture?
faq.sessions_a2: Missing a lecture will affect your attendance rate. You need at least 70% attendance to be eligible for a certificate. Contact your instructor if you have a valid reason for missing.
faq.sessions_q3: Can I watch a recorded lecture?
faq.sessions_a3: If your instructor has enabled lecture recording, you can access recordings from the course learning page under the Lectures tab.
faq.assessments_a1: Assessments are graded automatically for multiple-choice questions. Written responses are reviewed by your instructor. You need to meet the passing marks set for each assessment.
faq.assessments_a2: Retake policies vary by course. Some assessments allow multiple attempts while others are limited. Check the assessment details for the specific retake policy.
faq.assessments_q3: What counts as a missing task?
faq.assessments_a3: A missing task is an assessment or assignment that is past its due date and has not been submitted. You can view your missing tasks from the My Courses page.
faq.certificates_q1: How do I get my certificate?
faq.certificates_a1: Once you complete a course (100% progress), a certificate request is automatically submitted. Your instructor will review it and approve it if you meet the eligibility criteria (70%+ attendance and passed all assessments).
faq.certificates_q2: How can I verify my certificate?
faq.certificates_a2: Each certificate has a unique QR code and Certificate ID. You can scan the QR code or visit the verification page and enter your Certificate ID to verify its authenticity.
faq.certificates_q3: Why was my certificate request rejected?
faq.certificates_a3: Certificate requests may be rejected if you don't meet the eligibility criteria: minimum 70% attendance, all assessments passed, and 100% course completion. Check your eligibility status on the Certificates page.
faq.technical_q1: I'm having trouble loading the dashboard. What should I do?
faq.technical_a1: Try refreshing the page, clearing your browser cache, or switching to a different browser. If the issue persists, submit a support ticket and our team will assist you.
faq.technical_q2: How do I reset my password?
faq.technical_a2: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and enter your email address. You'll receive a password reset link. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.
faq.technical_a3: We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. For the best experience, we recommend using Google Chrome.

payments.activeGatewayHelp: The gateway selected here is what new checkout sessions use. Existing sessions continue with whatever they started with.
payments.testModeDesc: Use sandbox credentials. Real card data is not charged.
payments.credentialsHelp: Secret keys are stored as references — the actual value lives in GCP Secret Manager and is rotated via gcloud, not edited here.
payments.publishableKeyHelp: Safe to expose to the browser. Used on the checkout page.
payments.secretKeyHelp: Server-only. Never sent to the client.
payments.merchantTokenHelp: Issued by Tamara on merchant onboarding

payments.bankTransferHelp: Students see these details on the checkout page when they choose Bank Transfer. Make sure the beneficiary name matches your registered bank account exactly.
payments.ibanHelp: Saudi IBANs start with SA and are 24 characters total.

glossary.title: Drift type glossary
glossary.subtitle: Each finding is tagged with one of these eight drift types. They tell you what's mismatched between our records and the gateway.

definitions.missing_local: Gateway has a record (e.g. a paid invoice), but we don't have a matching payment. Often means the buyer paid but our webhook didn't land — usually needs a manual enrollment.
definitions.missing_gateway: We have a payment row, but the gateway doesn't know about it. Almost always a test record or an abandoned attempt — safe to ignore once verified.
definitions.amount_mismatch: Our amount and the gateway's amount differ. Usually a discount or fee was applied on one side only — investigate or refund the difference.
definitions.status_mismatch: Both sides agree the payment exists but disagree on its state (e.g. we say PENDING, gateway says PAID). Often a missed webhook — refetch should resolve it.

supportPublicPage.faq1_question: How do I join a Zoom session?

supportPublicPage.faq5_question: Course videos are not playing. How can I fix this?
